items.body:
［２６日　ロイター］ - 愛知・名古屋アジア大会は２６日、マラソンを行い、男子では山下一貴が２時間１０分４９秒で金メダルを獲得した。

山下は２位サワン・バルワル（インド）を４８秒上回った。吉田祐也は２時間１８分３３秒で１１位だった。

女子では矢田みくにが２時間２７分５６秒で３位。２２キロ付近で転倒するアクシデントもあったが、銅メダルを獲得した。佐藤早也伽が２時間２８分１４秒で４位に入った。

シタイエ・ハブテ（バーレーン）が２時間２７分３１秒で優勝した。

items.title: Joey Logano gets Kansas pole as rain halts Chase qualifying
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: KANSAS CITY, Kan. - Joey Logano doesn't mind that rain has played havoc with qualifying for three of the first four races in the NASCAR Cup Series Chase presented by Mobil 1.
items.body:
KANSAS CITY, Kan. - Joey Logano doesn't mind that rain has played havoc with qualifying for three of the first four races in the NASCAR Cup Series Chase presented by Mobil 1.
With rain wiping out both practice and time trials for Sunday's Hollywood Casino 400 at Kansas Speedway (3 p.m. ET on USA, MRN and SiriusXM NASCAR Radio), Logano will start on the pole for the fourth postseason race.
"I'll take rain," said Logano, who earned the top starting spot through a combination of his victory last Saturday at Bristol Motor Speedway and the position of his No. 22 Team Penske Ford in owner points.
A three-time series champion - most among full-time active drivers - Logano enters the Kansas race third in the Chase standings, 16 points behind leader Kyle Larson, who will start Sunday's race beside Logano on the front row.
"Starting up front is always good," Logano said. "We'll see if we have enough pace when you're up there. You have a lot of fast cars around you. We'll see what we've got."
Logano was first out during a scheduled practice session that was halted by rain almost before it began.
"In a perfect world, we would have gotten to practice, and it rained out qualifying," Logano quipped. "I thought we were practicing and qualifying when I showed up at the race track this morning. The radar looked pretty good, and the forecast didn't look that bad either.
"I thought ‘We are going to have to do it the hard way today.' I guess it rained just enough. The curiosity is going to get the best of me, and I am going to want to know what we've got. But I can wait one more night. I will be OK."
Christopher Bell and Carson Hocevar will start third and fourth, respectively, as Chase drivers occupy the first nine positions on the grid. Ty Gibbs starts fifth, followed by Denny Hamlin (who trails Larson by one point), Bubba Wallace, William Byron and Ryan Preece.
Tenth-place starter Josh Berry is the only non-Chase driver in the top 10.
Other Chase drivers will take the green flag from the following positions: Austin Cindric 11th, Chris Buescher 12th, Daniel Suarez 14th, Tyler Reddick 15th, Chase Elliott 18th, Chase Briscoe 23rd and Ryan Blaney 25th.
The qualifying rainout is particularly tough on Blaney, who will start deep in the field for the second straight week after wrecking out of the Bristol race while contesting second place with Hocevar.

items.title: Internationals keep upset hopes alive at Presidents Cup
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The International Team kept its hopes of a huge Presidents Cup upset alive on Saturday, taking a three point lead over the United States into Sunday's singles as they seek their first outright victory at the biennial event since 1998.
items.body:
The International Team kept its hopes of a huge Presidents Cup upset alive on Saturday, taking a three point lead over the United States into Sunday's singles as they seek their first outright victory at the biennial event since 1998.
The Internationals, comprised of players from outside the US and Europe, saw their 7-3 lead cut into in the morning as Scottie Scheffler and Sam Burns won each of the final three holes to defeat Japan's Hideki Matsuyama and Ryo Hisatsune 2 and 1 in the last fourball match.
That trimmed the US deficit to three points ahead of four afternoon foursomes matches, where the Internationals would battle to a 2-2 split powered by a comeback by the Canadian duo of Nick Taylor and Corey Conners, who were three down through 10 but came back to beat Russell Henley and Jacob Bridgeman 1-up.
"There was no giving up," Conners said.
"We knew it was going to be a battle. We gave them a few holes early on and I think we were both motivated to try to get back on the right side of things."
The Internationals have a 10-1/2 to 7-1/2 advantage and need five of the 12 available points to end their title drought against the US, who have won the past 10 Presidents Cups.
The 2026 edition marks the first time the Internationals have led on foreign soil heading into Sunday in the event's history
US Captain Brandt Snedeker, who made the surprising decision to sit world number one Scheffler for the afternoon session, said he was proud of his squad's effort at the difficult Medinah Country Club's No. 3 Course near Chicago.
Scheffler has struggled in team golf competitions in the past, and Snedeker appeared to want to take some of the pressure off of the four-time major champion's shoulders.
"I challenged the guys this afternoon to go out there and be that team that we needed to be," he said.
"We got Scottie some much needed rest so he can go out there tomorrow and be the Scottie Scheffler we know that he is."

items.title: トランプ氏、イラン提示のホルムズ海峡開放案拒否
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Trevor Hunnicutt　Parisa Hafezi　Menna AlaaElDin

[ワシントン／国連／カイロ ２７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Trevor Hunnicutt　Parisa Hafezi　Menna AlaaElDin

[ワシントン／国連／カイロ ２７日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２６日、ホルムズ海峡開放と中東での戦闘終結に向けたイランの提案を拒否したと表明した。

イランはニューヨークで開催された国連総会の場でこの構想を提示。仲介役のカタールを通じて米側に伝達されたとし、実行されれば７日以内にホルムズ海峡を開放し、戦闘を終結させることが可能だと説明していた。

しかしトランプ氏はホワイトハウスで記者団に「彼らの提案を拒否した。彼らの取引を拒絶した」と断言。「彼らはあまりにも劣勢に立たされているため、ホルムズ海峡を直ちに開放するための取引をしたがっている。われわれは圧倒的に勝っている」と語った。

一方、イランは２７日、米およびイスラエルとの紛争は外交によってのみ解決できると強調した。

アラグチ外相は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）に「われわれの条件は明確であり、ホルムズ海峡開放に向けたいかなる動きも、これらの条件が満たされることが前提だ」と投稿。「交渉による解決のみが膠着状態を打開できる」と述べた。

アラグチ氏は、仲介国からはまだ、米国による提案拒否を正式には伝えられていないと説明し「仲介国から最終的な見解を伝えられるのを待っており、それに基づいて決定を下す」と述べた。

items.title: 【焦点】米雇用は9月も堅調の見込み、コスト圧力でも景気に勢い
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国ではコスト圧力が強まっているにもかかわらず、景気の勢いが増しており、9月の雇用は2カ月連続で堅調だったとみられる。

エコノミスト予想では、来月2日に発表される9月の雇用統計で、非農業部門雇用者数が約9万人増加すると見込まれている。前月は3月以来の大きな伸びとなっていた。失業率は4.1%にとどまる見通しだ。

最近の雇用が拡大している背景には、当然ながら景気そのものの強さがある。需要関連の指標は、旺盛な設備投資が続いているほか、個人消費も改善していることを示している。こうした状況を背景に、米金融当局は政策の焦点をインフレに明確に移すことが可能になった。

一方、30日発表される8月のインフレ調整後の個人消費支出（PCE）は前月比0.5%増加すると予想されており、この通りなら1年余りで最大の伸びとなる。

これには米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が重視するインフレ指標も含まれる。PCE価格指数と、エネルギーと食品を除くコア指数はいずれも、8月に前月比で伸びが加速すると見込まれている。

投資家はこうした統計を受け、米金融当局が今月の利上げに続き、10月の連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）会合でも追加利上げに踏み切るかどうかを見極めることになる。現時点では、来月に0.25ポイントの利上げが実施されるとの見方が優勢だ。

ブルームバーグ・エコノミクスのアナ・ウォン、アンドリュー・サッチャー、エリザ・ウィンガー各氏は「2カ月分のデータを見る限り、7－9月（第3四半期）も消費は底堅さを維持し、実質消費は年率3%を超える伸びとなる見通しだ。個人所得は0.5%増（前月0.4%増）に加速した可能性が高く、消費を支えている」と分析した。

原題：US Hiring Appetite Is Healthy as Economy Powers Ahead: Eco Week（抜粋）

items.title: Irán insiste en una solución diplomática tras el rechazo de Trump al plan de paz
items.author: Trevor Hunnicutt, Yomna Ehab, Parisa Hafezi, Menna Alaaeldin
items.creator: Trevor Hunnicutt, Yomna Ehab, Parisa Hafezi, Menna Alaaeldin
items.summary: Irán insistió el domingo en que solo la diplomacia puede resolver su conflicto con Estados Unidos e Israel, después de que el presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, afirmara que rechazaba una propuesta iraní para reabrir el estrecho de Ormuz y poner fin a los combates.
items.body:
Irán insistió el domingo en que solo la diplomacia puede resolver su conflicto con Estados Unidos e Israel, después de que el presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, afirmara que rechazaba una propuesta iraní para reabrir el estrecho de Ormuz y poner fin a los combates.
"Nuestras condiciones son claras, y cualquier medida para reabrir el estrecho de Ormuz depende de que se cumplan dichas condiciones", publicó el ministro de Asuntos Exteriores iraní, Abbas Araqchi, en las redes sociales. "Solo una solución negociada puede sacarles de este punto muerto".
Irán anunció una propuesta de paz a principios de esta semana en la Asamblea General de la ONU en Nueva York, afirmando que había sido transmitida a los estadounidenses a través de mediadores qataríes. Trump declaró el sábado que rechazaba el plan y argumentó que la desesperación impulsa el empeño de los iraníes por alcanzar un acuerdo sobre esta vía navegable clave.
"Quieren llegar a un acuerdo para abrir el estrecho de Ormuz de inmediato porque están saliendo muy mal parados", declaró Trump a los periodistas en la Casa Blanca.
A pesar de las declaraciones públicas de Trump, los mediadores que facilitan las conversaciones entre Estados Unidos e Irán no han transmitido oficialmente el rechazo estadounidense al plan, según Araqchi.
"Estamos a la espera de que los mediadores nos transmitan las opiniones definitivas, y tomaremos una decisión basándonos en ellas", publicó Araqchi.
Estados Unidos ha impuesto un bloqueo económico a Irán para presionar a Teherán a fin de que ponga fin a los ataques iraníes contra buques en el estrecho de Ormuz, que han reducido drásticamente el tráfico marítimo en la zona, a pesar de que Trump afirme repetidamente que Estados Unidos controla la vía navegable.
El Wall Street Journal fue el primero en informar que Trump había rechazado la propuesta iraní, citando a funcionarios estadounidenses anónimos.
Según el diario, Trump se mostraba escéptico en privado respecto a que Irán accediera a sus exigencias y había comunicado a su equipo que consideraba probable una nueva campaña de bombardeos tras las elecciones de mitad de mandato de noviembre en Estados Unidos.
Un funcionario estadounidense había declarado anteriormente que las conversaciones con Irán a través de mediadores eran "positivas y constructivas".
IMPACTO EN FLUJOS DE PETRÓLEO Y ECONOMÍA MUNDIAL Los iraníes también mantuvieron conversaciones con sus rivales sauditas en relación con el estrecho de Ormuz, lo que pone de relieve lo que está en juego en un conflicto que dura ya siete meses y que ha interrumpido el flujo de petróleo a través de una ruta marítima crucial y ha pasado factura a la economía mundial.
Araqchi declaró el viernes a los periodistas en las Naciones Unidas que el acuerdo propuesto daría lugar a una cuenta atrás de siete días para la reapertura del estrecho y a una tregua en los combates regionales.
"Si existe seriedad por parte de Estados Unidos para llegar a un acuerdo y reabrir el estrecho de Ormuz, ya está todo preparado", afirmó Araqchi. Si Estados Unidos aceptara, las partes beligerantes podrían iniciar conversaciones más amplias "sobre temas acordados mutuamente".
Esto podría incluir, potencialmente, debates sobre el programa nuclear iraní. Trump ha afirmado que Teherán no debe adquirir jamás una bomba nuclear, mientras que un alto cargo iraní declaró a Reuters que Irán no mostraría ninguna flexibilidad respecto a su programa nuclear, incluso si Estados Unidos aceptara su acuerdo de paz.

items.title: Michael Harris II’s 4 hits help lift Braves past Marlins
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Michael Harris II had four hits and Dominic Smith and Drake Baldwin each hit a two-run home run, leading the Atlanta Braves to an 8-3 win over the Miami Marlins on Saturday afternoon in Miami.
items.body:
Michael Harris II had four hits and Dominic Smith and Drake Baldwin each hit a two-run home run, leading the Atlanta Braves to an 8-3 win over the Miami Marlins on Saturday afternoon in Miami.
Atlanta deployed a bullpen game against the Marlins in the second-to-last game of the regular season, trying to set up its rotation for the National League wild-card series the Braves will host next week.
Atlanta has decisions to make with its rotation due to multiple injuries. The Braves used an opener out of the bullpen for the second straight game on Saturday.
Brent Suter started for Atlanta and pitched three innings, allowing only one hit with three strikeouts. Victor Mederos (6-1) pitched two scoreless innings to earn the win.
Otto Lopez had two hits to raise his batting average to .305 and increase his major league-leading hit total to 191. He ended his day third in the NL batting race.
Jack Ralston (0-3) allowed three runs on three hits in 1 1/3 innings as the opener for the Marlins.
Harris led off the game with a double and scored on Matt Olson's sacrifice fly in the top of the first. Smith's home run in the second made it 3-0, and Ralston was replaced by reliever Victor Vodnik.
The Braves tacked on another run in the inning, and Harris doubled in Ha-Seong Kim in the top of the fourth to make it 5-0. Olson followed with an RBI infield single to make it 6-0.
Sanoja homered and Griffin Conine added an RBI single in the bottom of the fourth to cut Miami's deficit to 6-2. Heriberto Hernandez tripled in Lopez in the seventh to make it 6-3, but the Marlins could get no closer.
Baldwin capped the scoring with his 25th homer, a two-run shot in the ninth after Harris' fourth hit.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Enrique Hernandez belts tiebreaking HR as Dodgers knock off Giants
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Enrique Hernandez launched the second pitch of the ninth inning for a tie-breaking home run, Blake Snell made a healthy return to the mound and the playoff-bound Los Angeles Dodgers outlasted the host San Francisco Giants for a 4-3 victory Saturday afternoon.
items.body:
Enrique Hernandez launched the second pitch of the ninth inning for a tie-breaking home run, Blake Snell made a healthy return to the mound and the playoff-bound Los Angeles Dodgers outlasted the host San Francisco Giants for a 4-3 victory Saturday afternoon.
After watching the Giants (65-96) twice rally into ties following 1-0 and 3-1 deficits, the Dodgers (99-62) kept their hopes alive for a 100-win regular season on Hernandez's fourth homer of the year, a no-doubt blast to left-center field against Trent Harris (0-1), San Francisco's seventh pitcher.
Tanner Scott protected the one-run lead, stranding the potential tying run at second base in the ninth by striking out Christian Koss to lock up his 25th save. Evan Phillips (3-2), who served up the Giants' game-tying run in the eighth, was credited with the win.
Snell, who left his last start after one inning because of tightness in his left groin, made it through 77 pitches this time, allowing one run and five hits in four innings. He struck out three without issuing a walk.
San Francisco's lone run against the ex-Giant came in the third when Jonah Cox doubled, stole third and raced home on a sacrifice fly by Turner Hill.
Down 3-1, the hosts rallied into a tie with single runs in the seventh and eighth against the Los Angeles bullpen. Drew Cavanaugh's one-out triple drove in Drew Gilbert, who had walked, in the seventh, before the Giants set up Hernandez's late heroics when Hill doubled, took third on a Phillips wild pitch and scored on a Bo Davidson sacrifice fly.
Giants starter Matt Wilkinson worked the first three innings, serving up Mookie Betts' 23rd homer of the season, a solo shot, but no other runs or hits. He walked one and struck out two.
The Dodgers went ahead 3-1 in the fourth on RBI singles by Miguel Rojas and Tommy Edman.
Edman had two hits for Los Angeles, which beat the Giants for a seventh consecutive time.
Cavanaugh, who entered the game as a pinch hitter, had a double and a triple, while Davidson and Shay Whitcomb chipped in with a pair of singles apiece for San Francisco, which lost a fourth in a row.
The Giants collected four doubles and a triple in the game, but managed just a 9-9 tie in total hits with the visitors.
-Field Level Media

items.title: Top 25 roundup: No. 1 Texas holds off No. 14 Tennessee
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Colin Simmons tied the school record with five sacks and Raleek Brown rushed for two touchdowns as top-ranked Texas notched a 20-17 victory over No. 14 Tennessee on Saturday afternoon in the Southeastern Conference opener for both teams in Knoxville, Tenn.
items.body:
Colin Simmons tied the school record with five sacks and Raleek Brown rushed for two touchdowns as top-ranked Texas notched a 20-17 victory over No. 14 Tennessee on Saturday afternoon in the Southeastern Conference opener for both teams in Knoxville, Tenn.
Arch Manning completed 14 of 19 passes for 201 yards and one interception for the Longhorns during his first visit to Knoxville, where his famous uncle Peyton starred for the Volunteers in the 1990s. The Longhorns recorded 10 sacks and held Tennessee to 221 total yards. Rasheem Biles tallied a team-high 13 tackles and one sack.
Brown rushed for 67 yards on 17 carries and Ryan Wingo caught six passes for 74 yards for Texas (4-0, 1-0 SEC). Simmons, who also forced a fumble, tied the longstanding school mark set by Shane Dronett in 1990 against Texas Tech.
Qua Moss returned a punt for a touchdown. Faizon Brandon completed 17 of 29 passes for 145 yards and one touchdown, and Mike Matthews caught a touchdown pass for the Volunteers (3-1, 0-1). Tyree Weathersby accounted for 2.5 of Tennessee's six sacks, while Arion Carter had 11 tackles and recovered an onside kick.
No. 3 Notre Dame 49, Purdue 10
CJ Carr completed 14 of 22 passes for 237 yards, three touchdowns and one interception and added another score on the ground as Notre Dame cruised past host Purdue.
Micah Gilbert led Notre Dame (4-0) with 83 receiving yards and one touchdown. Aneyas Williams had 14 carries for 80 yards and a touchdown, while Cooper Flanagan, Nolan James Jr. and Matt Jeffery each had one receiving touchdown. The Fighting Irish outgained the Boilermakers 444-218, including a 177-40 advantage on the ground.
Ryan Browne completed 18 of 28 passes for 111 yards for Purdue (1-3). Fame Ijeboi was limited to 41 rushing yards on 12 carries. Backup quarterback Evans Chuba completed 7 of 9 passes for 67 yards and a touchdown. Bisi Owens caught Purdue's lone touchdown.
No. 7 Ohio State 42, Illinois 19
Jeremiah Smith caught a career-high four touchdowns, three in the first half, while Julian Sayin threw for four scores and ran for another, as the Buckeyes defeated the visiting Illini.
Ohio State (3-1, 1-0 Big Ten) led 28-10 at the half on the strength of Smith's TDs of 7, 72 and 9 yards and Sayin's 7-yard scamper with 15 seconds left. Smith became the first Ohio State player with three first-half touchdown receptions since Noah Brown at Oklahoma on Sept. 17, 2016. His fourth touchdown later tied the program's single-game record, also last accomplished by Brown in that game.
Quarterback Katin Houser was 21 of 37 for 263 yards, and a TD for Illinois (2-2, 0-1 Big Ten), and Hudson Clement made five catches for 87 yards. Aidan Laughery ran for 113 yards and Jordan Anderson rushed for a 22-yard TD.
No. 11 Texas Tech 49, Sam Houston 14
Linebacker Austin Romaine returned two interceptions for touchdowns on successive plays and Cameron Dickey rushed for 91 yards and two scores as the Red Raiders routed the visiting Bearkats in Lubbock, Texas.
Romaine, a Kansas State transfer, notched his pair of defensive scores just seven seconds apart in the first minute of the second quarter. Romaine grabbed a Brett Holloway pass that was deflected by Red Raiders linebacker Brock Golwas and returned it 15 yards for a touchdown with 14:54 remaining in the quarter. Then Romaine swooped in front of a Landyn Locke pass and raced 31 yards for another TD.
Will Hammond threw for 224 yards on 17-for-29 passing with one touchdown and three interceptions while adding a rushing TD for Texas Tech, which secured a 4-0 start for the second straight season and 12th time in program history. Meanwhile, Locke was 23-for-37 for 195 yards with two touchdowns and two interceptions for the Bearkats (1-3).
Wake Forest 30, No. 16 Louisville 27
Ty Clark III ran for two touchdowns and Wake Forest (3-1, 1-1 Atlantic Coast Conference) relied on a stout second-half defense to upset host Louisville. Connor Calvert kicked his third field goal -- a 32-yarder -- with 6:20 remaining to break a 27-all tie.
Wake Forest's Gabe Kirschke blocked a 57-yard field goal attempt by Nick Keller with 15 seconds left, preserving the outcome. Quarterback Gio Lopez completed 12 of 19 passes for 225 yards and a touchdown. Nine of those completions went to Carlos Hernandez for 194 yards. Clark gained 91 yards on 21 carries.
Louisville (2-2, 1-1) had a chance to pull even earlier, but Carson Hilbert missed a 42-yarder with 2:29 left. Hilbert had drilled a 54-yarder with 42 seconds to go in the third quarter to pull the Cardinals even at 27-all. Lincoln Kienholz ran for two touchdowns and threw for another for Louisville. He was 27 of 36 for 324 yards in the air with an interception.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Bangladesh apunta a recaudar hasta US$1.000 millones en su primera emisión de bonos soberanos
items.author: Arun Devnath
items.summary: La colocación de deuda se produce en un momento en que los países en desarrollo enfrentan mayores costos de financiamiento a nivel mundial tras las recientes subidas de tasas por parte de la Reserva F ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Bangladesh se está preparando para recaudar entre 500 millones y 1.000 millones de dólares a través de su primera emisión de bonos soberanos en moneda extranjera en los próximos tres meses, según informó un alto funcionario del gobierno. JPMorgan Chase & Co. se encargará de gestionar la próxima emisión, según declaró Tanvir Shahriar Ghani, asistente especial del primer ministro para asuntos de inversión y mercados de capital, en una entrevista el sábado por la noche. El plan de emisión de bonos requiere la aprobación final del primer ministro Tarique Rahman. La venta de deuda se produce en un momento en que los países en desarrollo enfrentan mayores costos de financiamiento a nivel mundial tras las recientes subidas de tasas por parte de la Reserva Federal de EE.UU. Ese contexto está determinando la forma en que Daca aborda la fijación de precios, señaló Ghani, quien encabeza el comité de emisión de bonos del gobierno. “Las tasas de interés han subido 25 puntos base, lo que tendrá un impacto en las tasas de los mercados emergentes. Simplemente vamos a ser cautelosos con respecto a la fijación de precios y, en función de eso, seguiremos adelante”, dijo. Si bien el gobierno está equilibrando sus necesidades de financiamiento, sigue siendo “sensible al costo del capital”, según Ghani. El interés por la primera emisión de deuda internacional del país parece sólido tras las reuniones no oficiales mantenidas la semana pasada con inversionistas institucionales en Europa. “El nivel de interés por los bonos soberanos es extremadamente alto”, afirmó Ghani, y agregó que las reuniones posteriores del gobierno en Nueva York también se centraron exclusivamente en los inversionistas institucionales. Ghani se negó a dar más detalles sobre la estructura de la transacción, alegando que existen ciertas “cuestiones legales” relacionadas con el acuerdo que deben tomarse “en serio”. El banco central de Bangladesh había planteado por primera vez la idea de emitir deuda para inversionistas extranjeros en 2012 y el gobierno volvió a considerar la propuesta más tarde, pero nunca se concretó. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Iran insists on diplomatic solution after Trump rejects peace plan
items.author: Trevor Hunnicutt, Yomna Ehab, Parisa Hafezi, Menna Alaaeldin
items.creator: Trevor Hunnicutt, Yomna Ehab, Parisa Hafezi, Menna Alaaeldin
items.summary: Despite Trump's public statements, mediators facilitating US-Iran talks with the United States have not officially relayed a US rejection of the plan.
items.body:
Iran on Sunday insisted that only diplomacy can solve its conflict with the United States and Israel after US President Donald Trump said he rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end fighting.
"Our conditions are clear, and any move toward reopening the Strait of Hormuz is contingent on these conditions being met," Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi posted on social media. "Only a negotiated solution can get them out of this deadlock."
Iran announced a peace proposal earlier this week at the UN General Assembly in New York, saying it had been transmitted to the Americans via Qatari mediators. Trump on Saturday said he rejected the plan and argued that desperation drives the Iranians’ push for an agreement on the key waterway.
"They want to make a deal to open the Hormuz Strait immediately because they're losing so badly," Trump told reporters at the White House.
Despite Trump's public statements, mediators facilitating US-Iran talks with the United States have not officially relayed a US rejection of the plan, according to Araqchi.
"We are waiting for the mediators to convey the definitive views to us, and we will make a decision based on them," Araqchi posted.
The US has imposed an economic blockade on Iran to put pressure on Tehran to stop Iranian attacks on vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, which have drastically reduced shipping through the area even as Trump repeatedly asserts that the US controls the waterway.
The Wall Street Journal first reported that Trump had rejected the Iranian proposal, citing unnamed US officials.
It said Trump was privately skeptical that Iran would meet his demands and had told his staff that he sees a renewed bombing campaign as likely after the November US midterm elections.
A US official had said earlier that discussions with Iran through mediators were "positive and constructive".
CONFLICT HAS DISRUPTED OIL FLOWS, HARMED GLOBAL ECONOMY The Iranians also engaged their Saudi rivals regarding the Strait of Hormuz, underscoring the stakes of a seven-month-old conflict that has disrupted oil flows through a critical shipping lane and taken a toll on the global economy.
Araqchi told reporters at the United Nations on Friday the proposed deal would trigger a seven-day countdown to reopening the strait and a pause in regional fighting.
"If there is seriousness on the US side to come to a deal and reopen the Strait of Hormuz, everything is now prepared," Araqchi said. If the US were to agree, the warring parties could start wider talks "on mutually agreed subjects."
That could potentially include discussions of Iran's nuclear program. Trump has said Tehran must never acquire a nuclear bomb, while a senior Iranian official told Reuters that Iran would show no flexibility over its nuclear program even if the US accepted its peace deal.
Iran would grant no concessions over its rights, including enriching uranium or shipping its highly enriched uranium out of the country, the official said.
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, in an interview with the CBS show "Face the Nation", said Tehran was ready for talks on its nuclear program and other issues, but would not accept "bullying or coercion".
"Iran is not seeking war, but will defend itself against pressure, threats and attacks,” Pezeshkian said, adding that it had already agreed that "we're not supposed to develop nuclear weapons".
Previous attempts at diplomacy have failed to end the war, which began on February 28 with US and Israeli attacks.
Since then the war has alternated between pauses and renewed strikes, killing thousands while degrading Iran's conventional forces and damaging Iran's already ailing economy.
Iran and its allies have retaliated by extending the conflict throughout the region. Iran has struck US allies in the Gulf with drones and missiles while its Houthi allies in Yemen have targeted Saudi interests.

items.author: Reuters

items.summary: Four people have been killed in a helicopter crash southeast of Montreal, police said on Saturday afternoon.
items.body:
Four people have been killed in a helicopter crash southeast of Montreal, police said on Saturday afternoon.
National broadcasters CBC and CTV reported that police said the crash happened at about 2:30 p.m. ET (1830 GMT) and that the aircraft was on fire when first responders arrived at the site near Sainte-Brigide-d'Iberville.
All four occupants of the aircraft were reported dead by the Surete du Quebec, the provincial police force.
Police did not immediately provide details about the helicopter's ownership, origin or its purpose for the journey.
Canada's Transportation Safety Board is deploying investigators.

items.title: Gordon's goal continues debate over England's footballing identity
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: England winger Anthony Gordon's exhilarating counter-attacking goal against Spain on Saturday may have provided strong evidence for his argument that the home side should embrace their own strengths rather than try to imitate the world champions.
items.body:
England winger Anthony Gordon's exhilarating counter-attacking goal against Spain on Saturday may have provided strong evidence for his argument that the home side should embrace their own strengths rather than try to imitate the world champions.
Days after saying England's DNA is built on direct and fast, aggressive football rather than the possession-heavy approach associated with Spain, Gordon embodied that philosophy with a superb 36th-minute goal in their 3-2 [USN:L1N45I06S TEXT:"Nations League defeat"].
England won the ball deep inside their own half and, within seconds, Jude Bellingham had surged forward and released Gordon, who sprinted clear and finished coolly past keeper Unai Simon.
"Kind of, if you want to phrase it that way," Gordon said when asked whether the goal reflected his vision for England. "I've been direct, playing to the English style, being quick, really putting teams on the back foot.
"(The goal) summed up what I said earlier this week which was quite nice, but it didn't lead to victory."
Gordon's strike sparked a four-minute burst that also produced Harry Kane's go-ahead goal, turning a 1-0 deficit into a 2-1 lead at Wembley.
Spain eventually recovered to win but Gordon left convinced England had shown they can compete with the top teams.
"We just lost to the best in the world. The gap is not big in my mind and I think tonight proved that," he said.
"When it went to 3-2 you see their ability to really control possession. I think against someone like that you have really got to go for the throat."
Playing in La Liga at Barcelona alongside and against some of Spain's finest, Gordon said he sees first-hand how different the Spanish approach is and that England should focus on their own strengths rather than trying to copy the world champions.
England boss Thomas Tuchel -- who also acknowledged earlier this week that the possession-style football of nations like Spain, Argentina and Brazil is not in England's DNA -- applauded Gordon's goal as an example of the attacking threat his side can carry when they play with conviction.
"Anthony Gordon's goal was a top transition goal," Tuchel said. "We scored amazing goals and could have created more if we were more clinical in the last 20 metres. We had an incredible amount of ball wins and the effort, bravery and courage was outstanding."
Ultimately, England's defeat came not from a lack of attacking ambition but from costly mistakes at the back.
Yet Gordon's performance ensures the debate over England's identity continues, with the winger adamant the route to major tournament success lies not in replicating Spain but in embracing the speed, intensity and chaos that have long been hallmarks of the English game.

items.title: Fever lose Tyasha Harris to season-ending broken fibula
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Indiana Fever will be without Tyasha Harris for the remainder of the season after the team announced Saturday that the backup guard suffered a season-ending broken left fibula in the regular-season finale.
items.body:
The Indiana Fever will be without Tyasha Harris for the remainder of the season after the team announced Saturday that the backup guard suffered a season-ending broken left fibula in the regular-season finale.
Harris was injured in the third quarter of Thursday's 86-66 loss to the Minnesota Lynx when she collapsed to the floor following a layup attempt. She had to be carried to the locker room.
Harris, 28, averaged 4.1 points and 2.0 assists in 39 regular-season games (four starts) and has appeared in 211 games (53 starts) through seven WNBA seasons. She entered the league as a first-round pick by the Dallas Wings in 2020 and played for Connecticut from 2023-24 before returning to Dallas last season.
Harris underwent season-ending knee injury on June 10, 2025, limiting her to only five games. She signed with Indiana in April.
In Harris' absence, Raven Johnson is expected to see increased minutes off the bench behind All-Star guards Caitlin Clark and Kelsey Mitchell.
The news was better for Aliyah Boston, who also left the game with a leg injury. Fever coach Stephanie White said after the game that it was a "flare-up" of an injury to Boston's right leg.
Indiana begins its best-of-three first-round series against the Aces in Las Vegas on Sunday.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Rangers place Josh Jung on IL; recall Robby Ahlstrom, Logan O'Hoppe
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Texas Rangers placed third baseman Josh Jung on the 10-day injured list Saturday with a right hand fracture.
items.body:
The Texas Rangers placed third baseman Josh Jung on the 10-day injured list Saturday with a right hand fracture.
Jung, 28, was hit by a pitch from Twins starter Joe Ryan in the first inning of Friday's 10-2 loss. Jung remained in the game and scored, but exited for a pinch-hitter in his next turn at the plate.
Jung finished the regular season batting .299 with 12 home runs and 42 RBIs, establishing career bests with 27 doubles and 35 walks. He was on the injured list from July 22 to Sept. 11 with a left calf strain. In 12 games after returning to the lineup, he batted .341 with three home runs and seven RBIs.
"That's pretty significant," Schumaker said after Friday's game. "Him and Joc (Pederson) both with hand fractures or wrist fractures, it's not ideal at this time of the year. But we've still gotta go. We have two games left, and we've gotta figure this thing out."
In other moves, the Rangers recalled left-handed pitcher Robby Ahlstrom and catcher/designated hitter Logan O'Hoppe from Triple-A Round Rock and optioned right-handed pitcher Gavin Collyer to the Arizona Complex League.
This will be the third big league stint for Ahlstrom, 27, this season. He has a 3-1 record with a 6.08 ERA in 42 relief appearances.
O'Hoppe, 26, batted .353 in 10 games (six starts) at DH during his first stint with the club. He was acquired via trade from the Los Angeles Angels at the trade deadline.
Collyer, 25, allowed two runs in two relief innings Friday. He is 1-1 with a 5.40 ERA and 23 strikeouts over 24 relief appearances in four stints with the Rangers this season.
Entering Saturday's action, the Rangers were tied with the Houston Astros for the American League West lead and battling for a postseason berth with two games left in the regular season. The Astros hold the tiebreaker over the Rangers with a 9-4 record in head-to-head games this season.
--Field Level Media

items.author: Dave Lee
items.summary: For someone mocked as a robotic, out-of-touch nerd, Mark Zuckerberg has struck the right tone with the Muse assistant, says Dave Lee for Bloomberg Opinion.

Commentary: Zuckerberg’s ‘Tamagotchi-like’ AI could be Meta’s iPod moment

For someone mocked as a robotic, out-of-touch nerd, Mark Zuckerberg has struck the right tone with the Muse assistant, says Dave Lee for Bloomberg Opinion.

Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg presents the Muse Charm during the Meta Connect event at the company's headquarters in Menlo Park, California, Sep 23, 2026. REUTERS/Carlos Barria

Dave Lee

Dave Lee

FAST

NEW YORK: Mark Zuckerberg is on to something. Hot on the heels of Meta’s hugely well-received launch of its Muse personal AI agent, Zuckerberg announced on Wednesday evening (Sep 23) the next phase: a “Tamagotchi-like” pendant for interacting with the cuddly assistant on the go. It’s slated to be out in time for Christmas.
Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman described some of Muse Charm’s features: A virtual Muse character appears at the centre of the screen, and users can customise its appearance, outfits, voice and other attributes. The device can be worn with a wrist strap, carried in a pocket or attached to a bag or keychain with a lanyard. A translucent case allows users to see the internal circuitry through the back and sides.
And then, what I predict will be a masterstroke:
Two users with Muse Charms can also allow their devices to recognise and interact with each other when they’re placed nearby.

How cute! For a man who in the past has been mocked for coming across as a robotic, out-of-touch nerd, Zuckerberg has struck a tone with the Muse assistant that has already set his company’s effort apart from his competitors – and prompted, I suspect, some hasty strategic rethinking.

Meta’s Muse Charm offers real-time voice and avatar interaction in a small standalone device that does not require a phone. (Photo: Meta)

STYLISH AND INNOVATIVE RECASTING Perhaps Meta’s secret is Alexandr Wang. The most-talked-about hire in Silicon Valley last year, Wang leads Meta’s artificial-intelligence efforts (and, I predict, will one day lead the whole company).
On Wednesday, on stage at Meta’s developer conference, Wang described Meta’s achievement perfectly when he said: “It was only about six months ago that having a personal agent running on your own computer was the sign of someone who was completely AI-pilled.”
Today, by refining the technology and adding some consumer-friendly touches, Muse is to AI agents what the iPod was to MP3 players: A stylish and innovative recasting of an existing technology so it struck a chord with everyday people. The rewards for reaching the non-nerds could be enormous.
The energetic arrival of the iPod marked the rebirth of Apple as a company. Muse – whether it’s accessed through smartphone, glasses or the Charm – has the potential to do something similar for Meta.
But there are challenges. Muse’s head start will be brief. OpenAI engineers are scrambling to come up with their answer. Siri AI is finally rolling out to the iPhone and seems pretty great. Zuckerberg might get a taste of his own medicine as companies with bigger AI products simply look at what he’s done with Muse and copy the best bits.
There’s also what we might consider Meta’s “trust ceiling” – the upper limit of users prepared to give Meta the kind of access that any useful AI agent needs. Meta is asking customers to trust it more than ever before.
Some will just say no. The question is how many. A Gallup poll conducted in June suggests consumer trust in big tech companies is low and sliding. The most recent Harris Poll 100 has Meta’s reputation among US adults trailing almost all of its peers, ranked 96th, compared with Anthropic at 16th, Apple at 20th and Alphabet at 22nd.
And yet, 3.6 billion people use a Meta app every day, and the company’s playful pitch for Muse is clearly hitting differently than the doom and gloom emanating from some other AI companies. They talk about AI putting us out of jobs and maybe wiping us off the face of the Earth.
Muse is instead channelling the sentiment expressed by author Joanna Maciejewska, who wrote in 2024: “I want AI to do my laundry and dishes so that I can do art and writing, not for AI to do my art and writing so that I can do my laundry and dishes.”

Related:

Commentary: How would AI kill all humans? Here are the top 5 scenarios

Commentary: AI armageddon looks different from China

A LUCRATIVE OPPORTUNITY Muse can’t do the dishes yet. But its usefulness for routine tasks is growing by the day – each one of them presenting lucrative opportunities for Meta to make serious money.
What made the iPod so transformational for Apple wasn’t just the device but the fresh business model it enabled with iTunes, a centralised and locked-in digital music store from which Apple took a hard-negotiated cut of sales.
That was, of course, the precursor to the App Store, which expanded that concept to digital goods of all kinds, turning Apple into the richest company in the world.
Meta is well positioned to run something like that playbook again, albeit in a more crowded market. “Over time we will profit by taking a small fee from transactions” made through Muse, Zuckerberg explained in his pitch to developers on Wednesday. Behind him, a slide stated, in giant letters, “Muse makes you money.”
For the first time in Meta’s 22-year history, the company has a new business model in its sights – AI subscriptions, hardware sales, cuts of AI transactions – that could eclipse the current one. 
Today, advertising accounts for 98 per cent of Meta’s revenue. I wonder how that might look in two years if Muse does indeed cement itself as the first breakthrough consumer AI agent.

Source: Bloomberg/el

items.title: Reds' starter Rhett Lowder baffles Blue Jays to even series
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Rhett Lowder pitched six scoreless innings Saturday afternoon and the visiting Cincinnati Reds defeated the Toronto Blue Jays 5-1.
items.body:
Rhett Lowder pitched six scoreless innings Saturday afternoon and the visiting Cincinnati Reds defeated the Toronto Blue Jays 5-1.
Lowder (7-12) allowed three hits and two walks with two strikeouts to finish the season with a 5.74 ERA.
JJ Bleday hit a solo home run for the Reds (75-86), who gained a split of the first two games of the season-ending three-game series with the Blue Jays (78-83). Hector Rodriguez added a two-run triple and went 2-for-4.
Lowder worked around two walks to open the home first with the help of a double play and was on cruise control for the rest of his outing.
Cincinnati took a 1-0 lead against Trey Yesavage (5-6) when Bleday led off the second by pounding a 1-0 fastball to right center for his career-best 24th homer of the season.
Yesavage, who was making his second start after arthroscopic knee surgery, allowed one run, two hits and one walk with three strikeouts in two innings.
The Reds added two runs against Spencer Miles in the third. Matt McLain walked and Carlos Jorge beat out a bunt single down the first-base line. After a double steal, McLain scored when Andres Gimenez fumbled Sal Stewart's grounder to shortstop. Eugenio Suarez followed by cracking an RBI double to left.
Cincinnati scored twice in the fifth against John Klein. Bleday walked with two out and took second when Sean Keys was charged with an error for misplaying Tyler Stephenson's cue shot along the first-base line. Both runners scored on a triple to left by Rodriguez over the head of Josh Smith, who backed into the wall and then had to chase the ball.
Lowder, meanwhile, had no trouble with the Blue Jays before Connor Phillips replaced him in the seventh and allowed one run.
Kazuma Okamoto led off with a walk, took third on Smith's double and scampered home on Gimenez's groundout to second.
Toronto got four solid relief innings from Klein, who allowed two unearned runs and fanned five Reds.
Cincinnati's Graham Ashcraft pitched around a single in the eighth and Tejay Antone took care of the ninth for the Reds.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Colorado WR DeAndre Moore injured on hit, leaves game
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Colorado Buffaloes lost wide receiver DeAndre Moore late in the second quarter after a hard hit during Saturday's game at Baylor.
items.body:
The Colorado Buffaloes lost wide receiver DeAndre Moore late in the second quarter after a hard hit during Saturday's game at Baylor.
With the Bears leading 10-3 and less than five minutes to play before halftime, Moore, Colorado's leading receiver coming into the day, went across the middle and reached down for a low pass from quarterback Julian Lewis. Baylor linebacker Travion Barnes also went low and hit Moore near the head and shoulders as the ball arrived to break up the play with 4:33 left.
Moore was down for several minutes before getting up. He walked off the field with help and went straight to the locker room. He did not return for the start of the second half.
Buffaloes coach Deion Sanders said afterward that Moore was doing good. Sanders believes Moore sustained a head injury.
"He's a warrior," Sanders said. "He was down like ‘you're not bringing out a cart, you're not bringing out a cart. I'm getting up and walking off.' I admire that from him so much."
The senior entered Saturday with 15 receptions for 200 yards and a touchdown. He spent the prior two seasons with Texas, grabbing 77 balls for 988 yards and 11 scores in Austin.
He did not have a catch Saturday before exiting.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Volley-Les Bleus battus en finale de l'Euro par la Pologne
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: L'équipe de France masculine de volley s'est inclinée contre la Pologne (31-29, 25-19, 20-25, 25-16) samedi en finale de l'Euro mais retrouve tout de même le podium continental, 11 ans après son sacre.
items.body:
L'équipe de France masculine de volley s'est inclinée contre la Pologne (31-29, 25-19, 20-25, 25-16) samedi en finale de l'Euro mais retrouve tout de même le podium continental, 11 ans après son sacre.
Dans un remake de la finale des Jeux olympiques de Paris 2024, les Polonais ont pris leur revanche à Milan (Italie) pour ravir un troisième titre européen, le deuxième consécutif.
La première manche, particulièrement accrochée, a fini dans l'escarcelle de la Pologne malgré quatre balles de set en faveur des doubles champions olympiques en titre. Les joueurs d'Andrea Giani pensaient même avoir empoché ce set initial mais un challenge vidéo a inversé le point décisif, avant que les Polonais ne concluent.
Peut-être abattus par cette issue cruelle, les Français ont très mal entamé la manche suivante et n'ont jamais pu refaire leur retard. Menés deux manches à rien, ils avaient alors besoin d'un miracle.
Le troisième set a laissé croire que celui-ci était possible puisque les coéquipiers de Moussé Guèye, précieux en sortie de banc, ont réduit l'écart.
Sauf que la Pologne a repris le dessus et fait la course en tête dans la manche suivante pour finalement s'imposer en quatre sets sur sa troisième opportunité.
La France conclut cependant avec une médaille d'argent une compétition qu'elle n'abordait pas parmi les équipes favorites, un an après son élimination au tour préliminaire du Mondial.
Cette jeune escouade, privée de la majorité des champions olympiques de 2024, avait difficilement débuté son été en terminant 10e de la Ligue des nations.

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Gonzalo has weakened into a post-tropical cyclone and is no longer considered a tropical cyclone, the U.S. National Hurricane Center said on Saturday, issuing its final advisory on the system.
items.body:
Gonzalo has weakened into a post-tropical cyclone and is no longer considered a tropical cyclone, the U.S. National Hurricane Center said on Saturday, issuing its final advisory on the system.
The post-tropical cyclone was located about 180 miles north of Sal in Cabo Verde and had maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (65 km/h), the Miami-based forecaster said.
"Additional weakening is forecast, and the post-tropical cyclone is expected to dissipate over eastern Subtropical Atlantic by the early to mid portion of next week," the NHC added.

items.title: Jefes de Asuntos Exteriores de Rusia y Alemania mantienen en la ONU primeras conversaciones desde 2022
items.author: Antoni Slodkowski, Tom Balmforth
items.creator: Antoni Slodkowski, Tom Balmforth
items.summary: Los ministros de Asuntos Exteriores de Rusia y Alemania se reunieron el sábado en Nueva York, al margen de la Asamblea General de la ONU, en lo que supuso la primera ronda de conversaciones de este tipo desde antes de la invasión rusa de Ucrania en 2022.
items.body:
Los ministros de Asuntos Exteriores de Rusia y Alemania se reunieron el sábado en Nueva York, al margen de la Asamblea General de la ONU, en lo que supuso la primera ronda de conversaciones de este tipo desde antes de la invasión rusa de Ucrania en 2022.
Las relaciones entre Moscú y Berlín, aliado cercano de Ucrania, se han enfriado desde la invasión rusa, y las tensiones se agudizaron aún más tras un incidente con un dron en el aeropuerto de Leipzig/Halle, en el este de Alemania, el pasado mes de agosto.
Como muestra de la persistente frialdad en las relaciones, el ministro de Asuntos Exteriores ruso, Serguéi Lavrov, declaró en una rueda de prensa que no había obtenido de su homólogo alemán, durante las conversaciones, ninguna información nueva que Berlín no hubiera ya hecho pública en sus comunicados oficiales.
"Le dije que, francamente... podría simplemente haberme llamado y haberme dicho: 'lee mi comunicado'", afirmó Lavrov.
Aun así, los ministros abordaron las relaciones bilaterales y la guerra en Ucrania, según informaron fuentes oficiales de ambas partes.
El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores alemán, Johann Wadephul, aprovechó las conversaciones para instar a Lavrov a hacer "todo lo posible por alcanzar un acuerdo sobre las exportaciones de cereales a través del mar Negro", según una fuente de la delegación alemana.
La reunión se produce en medio de los esfuerzos diplomáticos por reactivar las exportaciones de cereales y energía de Rusia y Ucrania a través del mar Negro, que se han visto drásticamente reducidas por los ataques a buques y a la infraestructura portuaria.
Lavrov declaró en la rueda de prensa que Rusia había mantenido conversaciones con la India, Egipto y Turquía sobre propuestas para garantizar la navegación segura en el mar Negro, lo que podría implicar acuerdos bilaterales entre Rusia y esos países.
"Es necesario mantener conversaciones por separado con los ucranianos, y no en tono de petición, sino más bien de exigencia", afirmó, culpando a Ucrania de los ataques a los buques.
Ucrania ha declarado que está abierta a acuerdos y achaca todas las consecuencias de la guerra a Rusia y a su invasión.
Wadephul le dijo a Lavrov: "El tiempo es esencial: dada la escasez de alimentos en muchos países —especialmente en el Sur Global—, todas las partes deben estar dispuestas a participar de forma constructiva", según la fuente de la delegación alemana.
El ministro alemán también señaló a Lavrov que "una solución pragmática podría allanar el camino para nuevos pasos concretos", añadió la fuente.
RELACIONES BILATERALES Como muestra de la delicadeza que entraña reunirse con el ministro de Asuntos Exteriores ruso en tiempos de guerra, Wadephul informó posteriormente a sus aliados europeos de la reunión en un mensaje al que ha tenido acceso Reuters.
"Aproveché esta oportunidad para reiterar nuestra posición sobre la guerra de agresión de Rusia contra Ucrania y para pedir un alto el fuego inmediato y completo, centrándome de manera urgente en las exportaciones de cereales y en la infraestructura energética", escribió.
El Gobierno alemán afirmó este mes que había llegado a la conclusión de que Rusia era responsable de ese intento de ataque con drones. Como represalia, cerró un consulado y un centro cultural ruso en Berlín.
La embajada rusa en Berlín ha desestimado las acusaciones calificándolas de "provocación inventada" y de "una nueva ola de histeria antirrusa en Alemania".
Wadephul aprovechó las conversaciones para instar a Rusia a "abandonar la peligrosa vía de la escalada frente a Alemania, Europa y la OTAN", según la fuente de la delegación.
Wadephul afirmó que incidentes como el intento de ataque en Leipzig o nuevos ataques híbridos no harían tambalear la determinación de Alemania de apoyar a Ucrania, según fuentes de la delegación.

items.title: World champions Spain punish England errors to win Nations League thriller
items.author: Lori Ewing
items.creator: Lori Ewing
items.summary: Spain's Mikel Oyarzabal scored the winner as the world champions capitalised on two calamitous England defensive errors to claim a thrilling 3-2 victory at Wembley on Saturday, in the standout fixture of the opening round of the Nations League.
items.body:
Spain's Mikel Oyarzabal scored the winner as the world champions capitalised on two calamitous England defensive errors to claim a thrilling 3-2 victory at Wembley on Saturday, in the standout fixture of the opening round of the Nations League.
Less than 10 weeks after lifting the World Cup, Spain, unbeaten in 39 games, made England pay in scoring their first two goals.
Teen sensation Lamine Yamal struck in the second minute when Marc Guehi was caught in possession deep inside his own half. Alex Baena scored on the hour after Nico O'Reilly's misplaced pass handed possession back to the visitors.
Oyarzabal, who also got the winner against England in the 2024 European Championship final, struck the decider in the 74th minute with a clever dink over goalkeeper James Trafford.
"There are many matches within a match and we've known how to play them all at every moment," Spain coach Luis de la Fuente said. "England has a lot of talent to hurt at any moment, but we've controlled the game."
Spain's victory spoiled what had briefly looked like being a memorable England comeback -- and a small measure of redemption after their heartbreaking World Cup semi-final loss to Argentina.
England had turned the game on its head in a thrilling four-minute span, with Anthony Gordon's 36th-minute equaliser sparking a blistering spell that culminated in captain Harry Kane heading the hosts in front.
"We're playing against the world champions, the European champions, and we went toe-to-toe," Kane told ITV. "On another day for sure we'd have won that game."
Kane was left shaking his head though after firing a second-half penalty off the inside of the crossbar when his left foot slipped upon planting.
"Terrible start, the worst start possible," England manager Thomas Tuchel said. "Makes it so, so difficult to be behind against this kind of team. The reaction was very good, very good.
"The third goal was the only one they really scored -- the others were from individual, big mistakes."
England and Spain had arrived at Wembley with very different World Cup memories. The Spaniards looked to build on their triumph, while Tuchel's men were still feeling the scars of defeat and aiming to show they could narrow the gap.
EVERGREEN MODRIC LEADS BY EXAMPLE In Saturday's other Group A3 game, Croatia gave new manager Slaven Bilic a 2-1 victory over the Czech Republic as evergreen captain Luka Modric once again proved influential before Marco Pasalic struck the decisive goal.
The 41-year-old Modric, still the heartbeat of the Croatia side more than two decades after his international debut, put the visitors ahead two minutes after the break.
The Czechs responded through Adam Karabec in the 54th minute but Pasalic restored Croatia's advantage with 13 minutes remaining to secure all three points.
The game marked a new start for both sides.
Bilic is back in charge of Croatia after Zlatko Dalic's departure following their round-of-32 World Cup defeat by Portugal, while Spaniard Santi Denia was appointed the Czechs' boss after their group-stage exit.
Scotland began life under Sebastien Pocognoli with a 0-0 draw away to Slovenia in Group B1, offering glimpses of the more attacking style the Belgian hopes to implement following manager Steve Clarke's departure after Scotland's World Cup exit.
Oli McBurnie, back in the Scotland fold after a five-year absence, had some of the best chances but a string of brilliant saves from Jan Oblak had the Scots settling for a point.
Switzerland made an impressive start to their first League B campaign, with Remo Freuler opening the scoring and Zeki Amdouni netting the first of his two goals before halftime en route to a 3-0 win away to North Macedonia.
Finland's Joel Pohjanpalo scored a hat-trick to help his country to a 7-0 thrashing of San Marino in Group C1.

items.title: Tigers walk off Pirates to win Justin Verlander’s farewell start
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Eduardo Valencia hit a two-out, two-strike, two-run home run in the ninth inning to lift the host Detroit Tigers to a 4-3 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates Saturday in Justin Verlander's final start.
items.body:
Eduardo Valencia hit a two-out, two-strike, two-run home run in the ninth inning to lift the host Detroit Tigers to a 4-3 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates Saturday in Justin Verlander's final start.
The Tigers were down 3-1 in the ninth with Verlander on the hook for the loss.
Facing Pirates closer Mason Montgomery (6-4), Max Clark singled with one out and Hao-Yu Lee doubled him to third. Kevin McGonigle brought Lee in with a groundout to make it 3-2.
Valencia ended it with a homer just over the fence in left.
Jacob Waguespack (2-2) picked up the win in relief.
Verlander gave up five hits and two runs in 5 1/3 innings. The right-hander walked one and struck out six in 91 pitches.
It was the 43-year-old's first start since March 30 and just his second start in his second stint with the Tigers.
A hip injury landed him on the injured list, and hamstring issues kept him out for months. He announced he was retiring during the season and the Tigers (76-85) decided to give him his last start at home on the next-to-last day of the season.
He did not make a minor league rehab start, instead building up through live batting practice, a simulated inning and bullpen sessions. He said he would have been happy with 20 pitches.
Instead, in his 557th career start, Verlander allowed only two runs, both on solo homers, and pitched into the sixth inning.
After Brandon Lowe fouled out to the catcher to start the sixth, Detroit manager AJ Hinch left the dugout and detoured toward the stands to bring Genevieve, Verlander's seven-year-old daughter, onto the field to sprint to the mound and take her dad out of the game.
Verlander pitched for the Tigers from 2005-2017. It was his first start in Detroit in a Tigers uniform since August 20, 2017. He finished his career 266-159.
The Pirates (81-80) need to win Sunday to finish over .500 for the first time since 2018 and avoid the sweep.
Lowe gave the Pirates the early lead with a home run to lead off the second.
Jacob Gonzalez made it 2-0 with a two-out shot deep into the right field stands.
Javier Baez doubled home Spencer Torkelson in the sixth to pull Detroit within 2-1, but Bryan Reynolds restored Pittsburgh's two-run lead with an RBI triple in the eighth.
Kirby Yates was the opener for the Pirates, giving up two hits and no runs in 1 2/3 innings. The right-hander had no walks and struck out one on 28 pitches.
--Field Level Media

items.title: 中国、中東情勢巡り主権尊重主張　国連演説で暗に米国批判
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Antoni Slodkowski

［国連　２６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Antoni Slodkowski

［国連　２６日　ロイター］ - 中国の韓正国家副主席は２６日、国連総会一般討論で演説し、湾岸諸国の主権を尊重すべきだと主張するとともに、「関係国」に対し、キューバへの威嚇をやめ、同国に対する封鎖を解除するよう求めた。

イラン戦争や米国によるキューバへの圧力を念頭にしたものだが、米国を名指ししなかった。

韓氏は「大国は国際平和と安全の維持に特別な責任を負うべきであり、規則の順守、法の支配の擁護、正しい行動に率先して取り組む必要がある」とし、「中国は、湾岸諸国を含む中東各国の主権と安全を尊重すべきだと考える」とした。

パデュー駐中国米大使は２５日、トランプ米大統領は２４日に行った中国の習近平国家主席との会談で、中国によるイラン支援は容認できないと明確に伝え、習主席は支援しないと確約したと述べた。

中国とイランを巡っては、中国が携行式防空ミサイル発射装置をイランに供給したとの報道や、中国の支援を受けてイランが石油販売石油販売に対する制裁を回避する手段を見いだしたといった報道が出ている。

＜キューバ封鎖解除要求＞

韓氏はキューバについて、「中国は関係国に対し、キューバへの武力行使の威嚇を直ちにやめ、キューバに対する封鎖と制裁を即時かつ全面的に解除するよう求める」と述べた。

キューバでは米国が１月に始めた石油封鎖により停電が深刻化している。

韓氏は演説で、中国は国際舞台で信頼できるパートナーであり、途上国の揺るぎない擁護者だとした。

「中国は、大小を問わず全ての国が国際社会の平等な一員であり、世界の問題は全ての国が協議を通じて扱うべきだと考える」と述べた。

items.title: Ronny Mauricio's 2 HRs help Mets take down Nats
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Ronny Mauricio homered twice, A.J. Ewing hit a three-run home run and the New York Mets beat the host Nationals 7-1 on Saturday in Washington.
items.body:
Ronny Mauricio homered twice, A.J. Ewing hit a three-run home run and the New York Mets beat the host Nationals 7-1 on Saturday in Washington.
Carson Benge had three hits and scored twice for New York, which evened the three-game series.
Jake Irvin had retired eight straight Mets entering the seventh. Benge led off with a single and, with two outs, Francisco Alvarez walked. Ewing hit an 0-2 pitch out to right-center and the Mets led 3-1. Mauricio followed with a solo shot to right.
Benge doubled in the eighth and scored on a two-out grounder that shortstop Nasim Nunez misplayed for an error.
In the ninth, Ewing walked and Mauricio hit his second homer of the game and third of the season to make it 7-1. Two batters later Juan Soto was hit by a pitch on the right hand and left the game.
Dedniel Nunez (2-1) pitched a scoreless sixth with three strikeouts to earn the win.
James Wood had two of Washington's three hits.
Irvin (2-10) gave up five runs (four earned) on seven hits over five innings of relief.
Mets rookie Jonah Tong gave up a run on three hits over five innings in his final start of the season. He struck out a career-high nine batters and walked one.
Washington starter Connelly Early pitched three scoreless innings and allowed one hit in his Nationals debut. Early was obtained from the Boston Red Sox for Curtis Mead in July while on the injured list with elbow inflammation.
In the Washington third, Nasim Nunez was hit by a pitch leading off and Wood singled. After both runners moved up on a wild pitch, Abimelec Ortiz hit a fly ball to right center. Right fielder Benge made an impressive diving catch, but Nunez came home after the catch and the Nationals led 1-0.
Soto singled leading off the New York fourth, but Irvin picked him off. Bo Bichette and Benge singled, but Mark Vientos grounded out and Brett Baty struck out.
--Field Level Media

items.title: China y EEUU acuerdan entablar diálogo sobre IA y reducir aranceles durante visita de Xi
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Estados Unidos y China acordaron reducir los aranceles sobre productos por valor de 30.000 millones de dólares e iniciar un diálogo sobre inteligencia artificial, según anunciaron ambos países tras la visita del presidente Xi Jinping a Washington.
items.body:
Estados Unidos y China acordaron reducir los aranceles sobre productos por valor de 30.000 millones de dólares e iniciar un diálogo sobre inteligencia artificial, según anunciaron ambos países tras la visita del presidente Xi Jinping a Washington.
Las reducciones arancelarias se aplicarían a las exportaciones estadounidenses, como productos agrícolas, madera y cosméticos, así como a las importaciones de Estados Unidos, entre las que se incluyen pequeños electrodomésticos, juguetes y artículos de decoración, según un comunicado de la Casa Blanca publicado el viernes.
"Ambos países alcanzaron un consenso sobre las recomendaciones para un trato arancelario más favorable para 30.000 millones de dólares en productos no sensibles en ambas direcciones", afirmó la Casa Blanca.
La cumbre de tres días entre Xi y el presidente Donald Trump, que concluyó el viernes, se caracterizó por la diplomacia personal más que por grandes avances públicos. Xi ya aterrizó en Pekín, según informó el sábado la agencia estatal de noticias china Xinhua.
Ambas partes también acordaron crear un consejo comercial y ampliar los resultados de las conversaciones anteriores celebradas en Kuala Lumpur, según informó el ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores chino.
El acuerdo se produce tras la decisión de las dos mayores economías del mundo de prorrogar por dos meses una tregua comercial que debía expirar el 10 de noviembre, lo que permite disponer de más tiempo para trabajar en un acuerdo comercial potencialmente más amplio, según declaró el miércoles el secretario del Tesoro de Estados Unidos, Scott Bessent.
"Esta visita histórica ha enriquecido la relación constructiva y estable entre China y EEUU, ha mantenido la estabilidad general de las relaciones bilaterales, ha abierto un nuevo capítulo en las relaciones entre ambos países y tendrá un impacto de gran alcance en la paz y el desarrollo mundiales", afirmó el ministro de Asuntos Exteriores chino, Wang Yi, en un comunicado.
DIÁLOGO SOBRE LA IA En materia de inteligencia artificial, ambas partes acordaron mantener un diálogo sobre los riesgos y beneficios de esta tecnología —la próxima ronda de conversaciones está prevista para noviembre— y establecer un canal de comunicación para incidentes relacionados con la IA, según informaron el ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores chino y la Casa Blanca.
La Casa Blanca señaló que los líderes habían acordado utilizar el término "superinteligencia" en lugar de "inteligencia artificial".
En un comunicado aparte, el ministerio chino señaló que Pekín valoraba el uso de este nuevo término por parte de Washington.
A medida que la tecnología de la IA sigue avanzando, ambas partes deberían intensificar los intercambios y trabajar para alcanzar un consenso en consonancia con los nuevos avances, señaló.
Ambas partes también acordaron apoyarse mutuamente en la organización de la reunión de líderes de la Cooperación Económica Asia-Pacífico (APEC) y de la cumbre del Grupo de los 20, y ambos líderes tienen previsto asistir a los encuentros organizados por la otra parte.
En materia de política exterior, los líderes coincidieron en que Irán debe cumplir su compromiso de no desarrollar armas nucleares y en que ningún país ni entidad debe imponer peajes de tránsito en las vías navegables internacionales, según afirmaron ambos países.

items.title: Una fuerte tormenta provoca cortes de luz y deja en tierra a aviones en todo el noreste de EE.UU.Una fuerte tormenta provoca cortes de luz y deja en tierra a aviones en todo el ...
items.author: Brian K. Sullivan
items.summary: Una fuerte tormenta del noreste ha dejado sin electricidad a miles de hogares y negocios en el noreste de EE.UU., ha provocado la suspensión de cientos de vuelos y ha llevado a los líderes estatales a ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Una fuerte tormenta del noreste ha dejado sin electricidad a miles de hogares y negocios en el noreste de EE.UU., ha provocado la suspensión de cientos de vuelos y ha llevado a los líderes estatales a declarar el estado de emergencia. Se cancelaron, como medida de precaución, dos conciertos que la estrella del pop Ed Sheeran iba a dar este fin de semana en el Gillette Stadium, en las afueras de Boston. Los fuertes vientos azotaron la costa desde Delaware hasta Massachusetts el sábado, y se esperaba que las condiciones empeoraran en la ciudad de Nueva York a medida que avanzara el día, dijo Bob Oravec, pronosticador principal del Centro de Predicción Meteorológica de EE. UU. Se espera que las marejadas ciclónicas eleven el nivel del mar en tres pies a lo largo de la costa de Nueva Jersey y Nueva York, y aún más en toda Nueva Inglaterra. La luna llena del sábado por la noche empeorará la situación al elevar aún más las mareas. “Los peores efectos se sentirán esta noche y hasta la madrugada del domingo, desde el sur de Nueva Inglaterra hacia el oeste, pasando por Long Island hasta la Ciudad de Nueva York”, dijo Oravec. “Las inundaciones costeras serán el mayor impacto de esta tormenta”. La gobernadora de Nueva York, Kathy Hochul, declaró el viernes un estado de emergencia en la Ciudad de Nueva York y sus alrededores a medida que la tormenta se intensificaba, y la gobernadora de Nueva Jersey, Mikie Sherrill, hizo lo mismo en su estado. Desde Massachusetts hasta Maryland, 101.674 hogares y negocios se encontraban sin electricidad a la 1:15 p. m., siendo las zonas de Queens, Long Island y a lo largo de la costa de Nueva Jersey las más afectadas, según Poweroutage.com. Los árboles son especialmente vulnerables, ya que aún conservan sus hojas, lo que podría provocar la caída de ramas que derriben más líneas eléctricas. Mientras tanto, los trabajadores de la ciudad de Nueva York se preparaban para árboles arrancados de raíz y sumideros obstruidos ante la posibilidad de inundaciones, según indicó el alcalde Zohran Mamdani en un comunicado. El pronóstico de lluvia para la ciudad se duplicó a unas seis pulgadas el sábado, lo que provocó inundaciones costeras y dejó sin electricidad a unos 22.000 clientes, señaló Hochul en una conferencia de prensa el sábado por la mañana. “Esperamos que este patrón climático continúe e incluso se intensifique durante el próximo día”, dijo Hochul. “Esto podría, y de hecho ya lo ha hecho, derribar árboles y líneas eléctricas y provocar cortes de energía”. También se cancelaron el Global Citizen Festival en el Central Park de Nueva York y el festival de música y cultura All Things Go NYC. En Nueva Jersey, la tormenta inundó algunas carreteras costeras y de la bahía interior, dejándolas intransitables, y las autoridades instaron a los residentes a no circular por ellas. Sherrill señaló en una publicación en redes sociales el sábado que las condiciones habían mejorado temporalmente en algunas partes del estado, pero que se esperaba que empeoraran nuevamente más tarde ese mismo día. En todo Estados Unidos se cancelaron 425 vuelos, en su mayoría desde el Aeropuerto Internacional Logan de Boston y otros aeropuertos de Massachusetts, según informó FlightAware. También se cancelaron al menos 15 vuelos desde el Aeropuerto LaGuardia de Nueva York. Según indicó la Administración Federal de Aviación en su sitio web, era probable que se produjeran suspensiones de despegues y retrasos en Newark, Filadelfia, Washington y también en el Aeropuerto Internacional John F. Kennedy. New Jersey Transit suspendió su servicio de tren ligero River Line a lo largo del río Delaware, entre las estaciones de Florence y Cass Street, al sur de Trenton. El Long Island Rail Road suspendió el servicio en su ramal de Long Beach debido a las inundaciones del sábado. La Autoridad de Transporte de la Bahía de Massachusetts ha suspendido la mayoría de sus transbordadores de cercanías en el puerto de Boston y sus alrededores. El Servicio Meteorológico Nacional emitió alertas y avisos de inundaciones costeras, incluso para la ciudad de Nueva York, donde indicó que las mareas podrían alcanzar hasta tres pies más de lo normal en The Battery, en el extremo sur de Manhattan, y que olas de hasta 12 pies (3,6 metros) podrían romper contra la costa en Brooklyn y Queens hasta el domingo. Desde la costa de Nueva Inglaterra hasta la de Nueva Jersey, las ráfagas de viento podrían alcanzar las 60 millas (97 km) por hora. Oravec dijo que la tormenta seguirá siendo intensa en Nueva York y Nueva Inglaterra hasta el domingo, pero que se habrá debilitado para el lunes por la mañana, cuando los trabajadores deban regresar a la oficina. items.title: Mbappé fue diagnosticado con una hiperextensión de rodilla, según el Real Madrid
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El delantero francés Kylian Mbappé ha sufrido una hiperextensión en la rodilla izquierda, según informó el sábado su club, el Real Madrid.
items.body:
El delantero francés Kylian Mbappé ha sufrido una hiperextensión en la rodilla izquierda, según informó el sábado su club, el Real Madrid.
El capitán de la selección francesa ha abandonado el equipo nacional, tras verse obligado a abandonar el terreno de juego poco después de marcar el gol de la victoria en el partido de la Liga de Naciones del viernes, que Francia ganó por 1-0 a Turquía.
El jugador, de 27 años, recibió asistencia médica tras el gol y volvió brevemente al terreno de juego, pero volvió a caer al suelo momentos después y no pudo continuar, lo que llevó al seleccionador francés, Zinedine Zidane, a sustituirlo en el minuto 58 de su primer partido al frente del equipo.
"Tras las pruebas realizadas hoy a nuestro jugador Kylian Mbappé por los Servicios Médicos de Real Madrid se le ha diagnosticado una hiperextensión de la cápsula posterior de la rodilla izquierda", señaló el comunicado.
"Pendiente de evolución", agregó
La Federación Francesa de Fútbol había indicado inicialmente que Mbappé sufría una "lesión en un tendón de la rodilla" y que había regresado a Madrid para someterse a más pruebas.
El Real Madrid recibirá al Villarreal en LaLiga el 10 de octubre.

items.title: China e EUA concordam em dialogar sobre IA e reduzir tarifas sobre US$30 bilhões em mercadorias durante visita de Xi
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Os Estados Unidos e a China concordaram em reduzir as tarifas sobre US$30 bilhões em mercadorias e iniciar um diálogo sobre inteligência artificial, informaram os dois países após a visita do presidente Xi Jinping a Washington.
items.body:
Os Estados Unidos e a China concordaram em reduzir as tarifas sobre US$30 bilhões em mercadorias e iniciar um diálogo sobre inteligência artificial, informaram os dois países após a visita do presidente Xi Jinping a Washington.
As reduções tarifárias se devem aplicar a exportações dos EUA, como produtos agrícolas, madeira e cosméticos, assim como a importações dos EUA, incluindo pequenos eletrodomésticos, brinquedos e artigos de decoração, segundo comunicado divulgado pela Casa Branca na sexta-feira.
“Os dois países chegaram a um consenso sobre recomendações para um tratamento tarifário mais favorável para US$30 bilhões em mercadorias não sensíveis em ambas as direções”, afirmou a Casa Branca.
A cúpula de três dias entre Xi e o presidente Donald Trump, que terminou na sexta-feira, destacou a diplomacia pessoal em vez de grandes avanços públicos.
Xi já pousou em Pequim, informou a agência de notícias estatal chinesa Xinhua neste sábado.
Os dois lados também concordaram em criar um conselho comercial e ampliar os resultados das negociações anteriores em Kuala Lumpur, informou o Ministério das Relações Exteriores da China.
O acordo segue iniciativa das duas maiores economias do mundo de prorrogar por dois meses uma trégua comercial que deveria expirar em 10 de novembro, dando mais tempo para a busca de um acordo comercial potencialmente maior, afirmou na quarta-feira o secretário do Tesouro dos EUA, Scott Bessent.
“Esta visita histórica enriqueceu a relação construtiva e estável entre a China e os EUA, manteve a estabilidade geral dos laços bilaterais, abriu um novo capítulo nas relações entre os dois países e terá um impacto de longo alcance na paz e no desenvolvimento mundial”, afirmou o ministro das Relações Exteriores da China, Wang Yi, em comunicado.
DIÁLOGO SOBRE IA Sobre inteligência artificial, os dois lados concordaram em manter um diálogo sobre os riscos e benefícios da tecnologia, com a próxima rodada de discussões marcada para novembro, e acertaram de estabelecer um canal de comunicação para incidentes relacionados à IA, informaram o Ministério das Relações Exteriores da China e a Casa Branca.
A Casa Branca informou que os líderes concordaram em usar o termo “superinteligência” em vez de “inteligência artificial”.
Em um comunicado separado, o ministério chinês afirmou que Pequim valorizou o uso do novo termo por parte de Washington.
À medida que a tecnologia de IA continua a avançar, as duas partes devem intensificar intercâmbios e trabalhar em busca de um consenso, de acordo com os novos desdobramentos, afirmou.
Os dois lados também concordaram em apoiar-se mutuamente na organização da reunião de líderes da Cooperação Econômica Ásia-Pacífico (Apec) e da cúpula do Grupo dos 20 (G-20).
Em relação à política externa, os líderes concordaram que o Irã deve cumprir seu compromisso de não desenvolver armas nucleares e que nenhum país ou entidade deve impor taxas de trânsito em vias navegáveis internacionais, afirmaram os dois países.

items.title: Georgia replace manager Sagnol with Svanadze after Northern Ireland loss
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Georgia have sacked manager Willy Sagnol in the wake of their Nations League defeat at home to Northern Ireland, and appointed Ramaz Svanadze as the new boss, the Georgian Football Federation said on Saturday.
items.body:
Georgia have sacked manager Willy Sagnol in the wake of their Nations League defeat at home to Northern Ireland, and appointed Ramaz Svanadze as the new boss, the Georgian Football Federation said on Saturday.
Svanadze had been manager of Georgia's Under-21 side for the past five years, and has signed a contract until the end of 2028.
Sagnol had been in charge since 2021 and the Frenchman guided Georgia to their first major tournament when they qualified for Euro 2024, where they lost to eventual winners Spain in the last 16, but results since then have failed to live up to those heights.
In the most recent World Cup qualifying campaign, Georgia lost five of their six group games to miss out on the tournament, and Friday's 1-0 loss in Tbilisi was Sagnol's final act as national coach.
"Thank you, Willy Sagnol, for every minute spent in the Georgian national team and for the emotions we went through together on this historic path," a Georgian FA statement said.
Svanadze's first game in charge will be Monday's Group B2 game at home to Ukraine.
